Otherwise return unknown: failure to find an incomplete placement attempt does not itself resolve uncertain completion. A skipped support is unobserved, not a failure. Extra frogs outside the bowl neither establish requested progress by themselves nor negate a genuine placement inside it. Do not add requirements for frog count, realism, removal of extra frogs, or alteration of pre-existing bowl details.
